newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK bourse adopts ballot system for warrant issuers.
newsitem.headline: HK bourse adopts ballot system for warrant issuers.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong said in a statement it implemented on Friday a ballot system to decide the allocation of shares among issuers when the number of shares available is insufficient to allow all interested parties to issue derivative warrants on them.

Issuers seeking an allocation of shares must deliver by hand to the exchange an indicative term sheet giving details of their proposed issue. A ballot will be held on the day the indicative term sheets are submitted.
Shares will be allocated equally to allow as many issues by different issuers as possible, the exchange said.
The local stock market has recently seen a flurry of warrant issues.
